defectFoundByTheGate.firstRun: White pill ink on the pack's light canvas: the warn/success/error fills are light tints, so 12px bold status words measured 1.83:1 and 2.2:1 and the gate exited non-zero.
defectFoundByTheGate.resolution: Roles, not thresholds: --tag-ink takes the pack's own text colour and the info pill stays a neutral light fill, because the pack asks for ONE low-saturation accent and an accent-dark fill under white ink is the same mistake in another place. No AA threshold was relaxed anywhere.

howItShips: A third optional palette (?palette=stitch) under the standing owner ruling that a new pack's colours become a selectable theme rather than an override. Light side only: the pack names no dark values, and inventing them would turn a 1:1 reproduction into a guess. The default palette keeps --color-bg #060A14, --color-primary #316CFF and --color-text #F5F7FC, asserted per token.
packValueSource: docs/taskpacks/20261023-ui-kb/source/08_STITCH完整提示词.txt (视觉段); the six values are re-read from that file by design-lab/tests/test_workbench_stitch_palette.py at test time, so the theme cannot drift away from the adopted text without a test going red
